title: Headless TTW The Local Flavor (DLC04MQ01): from the Duchess Gambit's message in the Capital Wasteland through Tobar's ticket, the voyage and the siege of Calvert Mansion to Desmond's talk (stage 200, quest completed)

actions.text: Given: the player is out of Vault 101 in the Capital Wasteland, Following in His Footsteps (MQ01) at its first stage (10), and Enclave Radio on the air (CG04's sun-blind trigger at the vault door enables RadioEnclaveREF [observed]). DLC04MQ01 runs from the start; its script (DLC04MQ01SCRIPT [observed]) counts 30 s once the Enclave signal is on, then sets 10: the riverboat's message, the landing's map marker.

Path: Catherine's plea for her daughter (stage 20), Tobar's talk about Point Lookout (30), a ticket bought (50), the Duchess Gambit's voyage (100), Tobar's welcome (120), Calvert Mansion's grounds (130) and front door (150, the siege DLC04MQ02LD), Desmond's lines through the siege (160), both breaches sealed (165, 170), the last waves beaten (190), and Desmond's talk (200: the quest done, Walking With Spirits at 5).
Travel stand-in: to the Duchess Gambit's landing at the Potomac. Catherine on the dock asks after Nadine (stage 20, NadineSearch 1).

actions.label: catherine: are you going to Point Lookout?

actions.text: Stand-in for the barter: Tobar's 'I'm here to buy' line (DLC04TobarVendTickets) puts a ticket in his stock and opens the barter menu [observed]; the ticket bought is given here and its price taken. The quest's script then sets 50 [observed: DLC04MQ01SCRIPT, the player carries DLC04BoatTicket].

actions.label: milestone: DLC04MQ01 50, board the Duchess Gambit

actions.text: The riverboat's gangway (DLC04CapitalDuchessTravelActivatorSCRIPT [observed]): its message, 'Travel to Point Lookout' (button 1); after the fade the script sets 100, which puts the player on Point Lookout's landing and Tobar at his welcome marker.

Travel stand-in: up the road to Calvert Mansion; the player steps onto its grounds (DLC04MQ01MansionExtTriggerSCRIPT: stage 130, Desmond on the loudspeaker) and through the front door (DLC04MQ01InsideSiegeStartTriggerSCRIPT: stage 150, the siege's quest DLC04MQ02LD 10) [observed].

Stand-in for Desmond's walk through the mansion (his Say To packages DLC04MansionDesmondSaytoGreet to ...04, the AI's): each package's end sets the next line number of DLC04ManMasterSCRIPT, which has him say DLC04MQ02DesmondStage01 to the player once within 500 units, and each line's SayToDone (DLC04DesmondSCRIPT) moves DesmondGreetStage on; the fourth sets stage 160 [observed]. The player keeps by him.

Stand-in for Desmond's walk to the wall he waits at (DLC04ManDesmondWaitForPlayerREF): he is put there and the player walks up; both within 170 units, the master script blows the first hole [observed: dooncee 1].

actions.label: milestone: DLC04MQ01 160, seal the first breach

actions.text: Desmond at his cameras (DLC04ManStartSequenceSCRIPT, entered by him: the AI's walk) and the player at the dining-room door (DLC04ManStage01Start01aSCRIPT): the door shuts and tribals drop through the ceiling [observed: stage01doorclosed]. The player goes on up through the house.

Stand-in for the first breach: the gas trap by the attic hole (DLC04ManGasHack01REF, TrapGasFire01, enabled through its parent marker 0x0E003625; what enables that marker in play was not found [hypothesis: a trigger's linked reference]) is shot until it bursts: its last destruction stage disables it [observed: DEST of TrapGasFire01], which brings the ceiling down (stage 165). Headless the shot is DamageObject (the trap's health, 10): it reaches stage 1 (Destroy) but its self-damage (50 a second) does not carry it on to stage 2, and a Disable of a reference whose enable parent is on does not hold (World::is_enabled follows the parent); so the parent marker is enabled before and disabled after, as the burst would leave the trap.
Stand-in for the second breach, as the first: its gas trap (DLC04ManGasHack02REF, parent marker 0x0E00B802) shot until it bursts (stage 170).

Stand-in for Desmond's walk to the front hall for the last stand (DLC04ManDesmondReadyForFinalWave: its end sets the master script's timer and line 6, his 'If you have any mines' line, whose end starts the final waves [observed]).

Stand-in for the fight: the tribals of each wave (DLC04LvlManTribalFinalWaveSCRIPT, each death adds one to finalwavedeadcount [observed]) are spawned leveled actors with no names to kill by; the count is set as their deaths would leave it, wave by wave (4, 8, 12, then more than 14), and the master script opens each next door and at the end sets 190.
